conversation_history.content: Hi! I'm new to programming and want to start learning.

Hello! 😊 That's great! Starting with programming is an exciting journey. I'd recommend beginning with Python - it's beginner-friendly, has clean syntax, and is widely used in web development, data science, and automation. What are you interested in building?
I want to build web applications and maybe work with AI in the future.

Perfect! Python is excellent for both. For web apps, you can use frameworks like Django or Flask. For AI/ML, Python dominates with libraries like TensorFlow, PyTorch, and scikit-learn. Start with Python basics, then learn a web framework, and gradually move into AI concepts.
How long will it take to become job-ready?

With consistent practice (2-3 hours daily), you can become job-ready in 6-12 months. Focus on: learning Python fundamentals (2-3 months), building projects (3-4 months), learning a web framework (2-3 months), and creating a portfolio. The key is building real projects to showcase your skills!
